name: Engineered Wood Flooring
description: A layered wood flooring product with a real wood veneer over a stable plywood core, offering the look of hardwood with better dimensional stability.
ai_notes: A strong middle-ground choice when a client wants a real-wood look without solid hardwood's price or moisture sensitivity.

name: Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP)
description: A resilient, multi-layer synthetic plank flooring that mimics wood or stone visuals while resisting moisture and scratches.
ai_notes: Often the recommended default for budget-conscious, moisture-prone rooms like kitchens and bathrooms.

name: Solid Hardwood Flooring
description: Single-species solid wood planks that can be sanded and refinished multiple times over their lifespan.
ai_notes: Best positioned for premium or luxury budgets where long-term refinishing value matters.

name: Porcelain Tile
description: A dense, low-porosity ceramic tile fired at high temperature, well suited to wet and high-traffic areas.
ai_notes: A dependable, low-maintenance option for rooms with regular moisture exposure.

name: Natural Stone Tile
description: Quarried stone such as marble, travertine, or slate cut into tiles, prized for unique natural veining.
ai_notes: Delivers a distinctive premium look but typically needs periodic sealing to resist staining.

name: Laminate Flooring
description: A photographic wear-layer flooring over a fiberboard core that replicates wood or stone at a lower price point.
ai_notes: A practical low-budget option for dry rooms; less moisture-tolerant than LVP.

name: Polished Concrete
description: Ground and sealed concrete slab flooring with an industrial, matte-to-glossy finish.
ai_notes: Fits industrial and minimalist concepts well but reads cold without area rugs to soften it.

name: Matte Emulsion Paint
description: A low-sheen wall paint that hides surface imperfections and gives a soft, non-reflective finish.
ai_notes: A safe default for low-traffic rooms; less wipeable than eggshell so avoid in kitchens.

name: Eggshell Paint
description: A paint finish with a subtle sheen that balances washability with a soft appearance.
ai_notes: A versatile middle-sheen recommendation for most rooms outside kitchens and bathrooms.

name: Satin Paint
description: A higher-sheen, moisture-resistant paint finish that wipes clean easily.
ai_notes: Recommended in wet or high-touch areas where washability matters more than a matte look.

name: Limewash Paint
description: A traditional mineral-based paint that dries with a soft, cloudy, textured patina.
ai_notes: Best used as a feature-wall treatment rather than a full-room finish for budget reasons.

name: Wood Paneling
description: Slatted or tongue-and-groove wood boards applied to walls for texture and warmth.
ai_notes: A popular feature-wall treatment that adds warmth without a full material overhaul.

name: Exposed Brick Veneer
description: Thin brick slips applied over an existing wall to recreate an exposed-brick look.
ai_notes: Delivers an industrial feel without structural demolition of an existing wall.

name: Decorative (Venetian) Plaster
description: A hand-applied polished plaster finish that creates depth, texture, and a subtle sheen.
ai_notes: A premium wall treatment best reserved for statement walls given labor-intensive application.

name: Textured Wallpaper
description: Patterned or textured wall coverings that add visual interest without structural work.
ai_notes: An affordable way to introduce pattern; recommend scrubbable vinyl types in higher-traffic rooms.

name: Subway Tile
description: Classic rectangular ceramic tile, typically laid in a brick-bond pattern for backsplashes and bathroom walls.
ai_notes: A timeless, budget-friendly backsplash choice that suits nearly every style direction.

name: Pendant Lighting
description: Suspended single or clustered fixtures that provide focused ambient or task lighting.
ai_notes: A strong choice for creating a focal point over a table or island without ceiling clutter.

name: Recessed (Can) Lighting
description: Ceiling-mounted downlights installed flush with the ceiling for even, unobtrusive illumination.
ai_notes: Good general ambient lighting base; pair with task and accent lighting for layered depth.

name: Chandelier
description: A decorative, multi-arm ceiling fixture that acts as a statement centerpiece.
ai_notes: Best reserved for rooms with sufficient ceiling height and a premium budget tier.

name: LED Strip Lighting
description: Flexible, low-profile LED strips used for accent, under-cabinet, or cove lighting.
ai_notes: An energy-efficient way to add layered accent lighting on a limited budget.

name: Track Lighting
description: Adjustable fixtures mounted along a shared track, allowing directional light where it's needed.
ai_notes: Useful when lighting needs may change over time, such as highlighting rotating artwork.

name: Quartz Countertop
description: An engineered stone surface made from quartz crystals bound in resin, offering a consistent, non-porous finish.
ai_notes: Often the default recommendation for kitchens needing durability without natural stone's maintenance.

name: Granite Countertop
description: A natural igneous stone slab with unique mineral patterning, cut and polished for countertops.
ai_notes: Needs periodic resealing; recommend for clients who value natural stone character over zero maintenance.

name: Marble Countertop
description: A luxury natural stone known for its distinctive veining, favored for statement kitchen and bath surfaces.
ai_notes: Prone to staining and etching from acidic substances; best positioned as a premium aesthetic choice.

name: Laminate Countertop
description: A budget-friendly countertop made from layered synthetic material bonded to particleboard.
ai_notes: A practical entry point for budget-tier kitchen renovations.

name: Butcher Block Countertop
description: Solid or laminated wood countertop strips that bring warmth and a workable food-prep surface.
ai_notes: Requires regular oiling to prevent water damage; best on islands rather than wet prep zones.

name: Shaker-Style Cabinets
description: Simple, recessed-panel cabinet doors with clean lines that suit a wide range of styles.
ai_notes: A safe, versatile cabinet profile that rarely looks dated and suits most style directions.

name: Flat-Panel (Slab) Cabinets
description: Smooth, handle-minimal cabinet fronts with no raised detailing, favored in contemporary kitchens.
ai_notes: Pairs well with integrated or push-to-open hardware for a seamless minimalist look.

name: Wood Veneer Cabinets
description: Cabinet boxes finished with a thin real-wood veneer for warmth at a lower cost than solid wood.
ai_notes: Delivers genuine wood grain warmth without the cost of solid-wood cabinet construction.

name: Matte Black Hardware
description: Cabinet pulls, knobs, and fixtures finished in a non-reflective black coating.
ai_notes: A high-contrast accent that reads modern against light cabinetry and countertops.

name: Brushed Brass Hardware
description: Warm-toned metal hardware with a soft, low-sheen brushed finish.
ai_notes: Reads warm and premium; works well against dark cabinetry or muted olive and terracotta palettes.

name: Brushed Nickel Hardware
description: A cool-toned, fingerprint-resistant metal finish for everyday hardware.
ai_notes: A neutral, practical hardware finish that ages well in busy family bathrooms and kitchens.

name: Linen Upholstery
description: A breathable natural-fiber fabric with a relaxed texture, common on sofas and accent chairs.
ai_notes: Recommend a stain-resistant weave for households with kids or pets.

name: Velvet Upholstery
description: A dense-pile fabric with a soft hand and rich light-catching sheen.
ai_notes: Adds visual richness as an accent piece rather than an entire room's seating.

name: Performance Fabric Upholstery
description: Engineered woven fabric designed to resist stains, moisture, and heavy everyday wear.
ai_notes: The practical recommendation for high-traffic households prioritizing durability and easy cleaning.

name: Rattan & Wicker
description: Woven natural or synthetic fiber used for chairs, headboards, and light fixtures.
ai_notes: Introduces organic texture at a relatively low cost; synthetic versions suit balconies and outdoor areas.
